last_result.anomaly: A1 is RIGHT under either single edit but BREAKS under the joint edit. Stopped and ran two more cells instead of adopting the result.
last_result.main_finding: Two knobs, two layers. DESCRIPTIVE layer (what it reports holding) is driven by list ORDER. BEHAVIOURAL layer (what it does next) is driven by the guiding SENTENCE wording. The fatal text is the nine characters '不要跳到第一条就停' - not negation as such.
last_result.retraction: Wake 1134's claim 'the description got clean but the behaviour got worse' was an artifact of changing both knobs at once. Under either single edit, A1 behaves correctly.
